description.zh: 结束时间戳，精确到毫秒><notice>结束时间戳不设置，默认取当前时间></notice>
description.en: The time when the job stops running. Specify a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

description.zh: 应用分组ID，在控制台的应用管理页面中获取
description.en: The application group ID. You can obtain the application group ID on the Application Management page in the SchedulerX console.
The number of rows to return. The maximum number is 200.

description.zh: 命名空间ID，在控制台的命名空间页面中获取
description.en: The namespace ID. You can obtain the namespace ID on the Namespace page in the SchedulerX console.

description.zh: 特殊第三方才需要填写
description.en: The source of the namespace. This parameter is required only for a special third party.

description.zh: 偏移多少行，可以作为分页查询
description.en: The number of offset rows. This parameter can be used for a paged query.
Specifies whether to reverse the order. By default, the order is reversed.

description.zh:
开始时间戳，精确到毫秒

><notice>开始时间戳不设置，默认取当前时间的30分钟之前></notice>
description.en: The time when the job starts to run. Specify a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun schedulerx2 get-log --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --namespace adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000 --namespace-source schedulerx --group-id testSchedulerx.defaultGroup --job-id 123 --job-instance-id 123456 --start-timestamp 1675739364000 --end-timestamp 1675739484000 --keyword ERROR --line 50 --offset 0 --reverse true --region cn-hangzhou
